design_description: A sleek heritage-inspired design featuring a matte black base accented by thin vertical gold pinstripes for a refined, premium look. The minimalist stripe layout is complemented by matching gold collar and sleeve trim, creating a balanced composition with a timeless football aesthetic. The clean front allows the elegant script sponsor and gold crest to stand out, while the back continues the pinstripe theme around the name and number. The restrained color palette of black and metallic gold reinforces a luxurious identity without relying on complex graphics or textures. Overall, the jersey feels sophisticated, classic, and premium, blending traditional pinstripe styling with modern minimalist execution.
